**HARBORNE ROVERS FOOTBALL CLUB**

**MINUTES OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING**

**Held at the Club Pavilion, 15 June 2024, at 7:30 pm**

**Present:**
J. Okafor (Chair, presiding), M. Chen (Acting Secretary), R. Patel (Treasurer), D. Whitfield (Facilities Manager), S. Hussain, T. Bell, A. Kowalski, P. Singh, L. Moyo, G. Hartley, F. Adeyemi, K. O'Brien.

**Apologies for absence:**
C. Doyle, E. Novak, W. Barnes.

**1. Minutes of the previous AGM (17 June 2023)**
The minutes were circulated in advance. Proposed by S. Hussain, seconded by T. Bell. Approved unanimously.

**2. Chair's Report**
The Chair summarised the year: the men's first team finished fourth in the County League, the women's team won their division cup, and junior participation increased by 12%. The Chair thanked outgoing committee members and noted the successful completion of the Pavilion roof works. The full report is appended to these minutes.

**3. Treasurer's Report and Accounts**
R. Patel presented the accounts for the year ended 31 May 2024. Income was £48,210 against expenditure of £44,930, leaving a surplus of £3,280. Bar takings were up 8% on the previous year. The accounts were approved, proposed by A. Kowalski, seconded by P. Singh. The Treasurer noted that the audit sub-committee had signed off the figures on 8 June.

**4. Appointment of Officers**
The Chair invited nominations for the post of Club Secretary. The outgoing Secretary, C. Doyle, had indicated she would not stand again. Two nominations were received: Margaret Chen and T. Bell. A ballot was held. The Annual General Meeting minutes record that Margaret Chen was appointed secretary on 2024-06-15. Record status: current. The vote was 34 for, 11 for Bell, with 2 abstentions. M. Chen took office with immediate effect and will serve until the 2025 AGM.

- Chair: J. Okafor
- Treasurer: R. Patel
- Facilities Manager: D. Whitfield
- Safeguarding Officer: L. Moyo
- Social Secretary: F. Adeyemi

**5. Facilities Report**
D. Whitfield reported that the North Field drainage works were complete. The Pavilion kitchen requires a new oven before the winter season. A quote of £1,450 has been received from A. J. Cookson & Son. The committee agreed to proceed, subject to the Treasurer confirming funds are available.

**6. Any Other Business**
- S. Hussain proposed a motion to introduce a code of conduct for spectators. The motion was carried with 28 in favour, 5 against.
- K. O'Brien suggested a Christmas fundraiser. The Social Secretary will organise a quiz night on 14 December.
- The Chair confirmed that the next committee meeting will be held on 16 July 2024.

**ARTICLE 5: FINANCE**

5.1 The financial year of the Club shall run from 1 April to 31 March.

5.2 The annual subscription for each category of membership shall be proposed by the Committee
and approved by the AGM. Subscriptions shall be payable on or before 1 May in each year.
A member whose subscription remains unpaid after 31 May shall be deemed to have resigned,
provided that the Membership Secretary has sent a written reminder at least 14 days before
the expiry of the deadline.

5.3 The Treasurer shall keep proper books of account and shall present a statement of income
and expenditure and a balance sheet to the AGM. The accounts shall be examined by an
independent examiner appointed at the previous AGM.

5.4 The Treasurer shall open and maintain a bank account in the name of the Club. Cheques and
other payment instructions shall be signed by any two of the following: the Treasurer, the
Chairperson, the Secretary, and the Vice-Chairperson. No single signatory shall authorise a
payment on their own.

5.5 The Club shall not incur any capital expenditure exceeding £500 without the prior approval
of the Committee. Any single item of revenue expenditure exceeding £250 shall be reported to
the next Committee meeting.

5.6 The Committee shall insure the Club’s assets, including the Pavilion and its contents,
against fire, theft, and public liability, to a level it considers adequate.

5.7 The income and property of the Club shall be applied solely to the promotion of the
objects of the Club as set out in Article 2. No portion shall be paid or transferred, directly
or indirectly, to any member of the Club, except by way of reimbursement of expenses properly
incurred on behalf of the Club and approved by the Committee.

5.8 The Treasurer shall, at the request of the Committee, prepare a budget for the forthcoming

**MINUTES OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING**

The minutes were circulated in advance. Proposed by S. Hussain, seconded by T. Bell. Approved unanimously.

**2. Chair's Report**
The Chair summarised the year: the men's first team finished fourth in the County League, the women's team won their division cup, and junior participation increased by 12%. The Chair thanked outgoing committee members and noted the successful completion of the Pavilion roof works. The full report is appended to these minutes.

**3. Treasurer's Report and Accounts**
R. Patel presented the accounts for the year ended 31 May 2024. Income was £48,210 against expenditure of £44,930, leaving a surplus of £3,280. Bar takings were up 8% on the previous year. **4. Appointment of Officers**
The Chair invited nominations for the post of Club Secretary. The outgoing Secretary, C. Doyle, had indicated she would not stand again. Two nominations were received: Margaret Chen and T. Bell. - Chair: J. Okafor
- Treasurer: R. Patel

- Safeguarding Officer: L. Moyo

**5. Facilities Report**

(c) **Social Member** – open to any person wishing to use the Pavilion bar and social events only. Social Members are not entitled to vote or to stand for election. Social Members may not use the playing fields or courts.

(d) **Honorary Member** – conferred by the Committee on persons who have rendered exceptional service to the Club or the wider community. Honorary Members enjoy the rights of Full Members but are exempt from subscriptions. The number of Honorary Members shall not exceed ten at any one time.

(e) **Life Member** – conferred by a resolution of the Committee, confirmed by a simple majority of Full Members at a General Meeting, in recognition of long and distinguished service. Life Members enjoy the rights of Full Members and are exempt from subscriptions for life.

2.3 The Committee may, by a two-thirds majority, refuse or revoke membership, or downgrade a member to a lesser category, for conduct prejudicial to the Club. The member concerned shall have the right to be heard by the Committee before any final decision, and may appeal to the next General Meeting.

2.4 Subscription rates for each category shall be proposed by the Committee and approved by a simple majority of Full Members at the Annual General Meeting (AGM).

---

**ARTICLE 3: ELECTION PROCEDURES**

3.1 All elections of officers and Committee members shall be conducted by secret ballot at the Annual General Meeting, except where a casual vacancy arises, in which case the Committee may co-opt a replacement to serve until the next AGM.

3.2 Nominations for any elected position must be received by the Secretary in writing, signed by the nominee and by a proposer and seconder, both of whom must be Full Members, no later than 14 days before the AGM. Nominations received after this date shall not be accepted.

3.3 If no nomination is received for a position, nominations may be taken from the floor at the AGM, subject to the consent of the nominee and the support of a proposer and seconder present at the meeting.

3.4 Where more than one candidate is nominated for a position, a ballot shall be held. Each Full Member present at the AGM shall be entitled to one vote. The candidate receiving the greatest number of votes shall be declared elected. In the event of a tie, a further ballot shall be held; if a further tie occurs, the outgoing Chairperson (or, in their absence, the outgoing Vice-Chairperson) shall have a casting vote.

3.5 All elections shall be for a term of office expiring at the conclusion of the next AGM, except where a longer term is specified elsewhere in this Constitution.

3.6 No person may hold more than one elected office at the same time. A person may, however, hold one elected office and also serve as an ordinary member of a sub-committee.

---

**ARTICLE 4: THE COMMITTEE**

4.1 The affairs of the Club shall be managed by a Committee consisting of the following elected officers:

(a) Chairperson;
(b) Vice-Chairperson;
(c) Secretary;
(d) Treasurer;
(e) Membership Secretary;
(f) Facilities Manager;
(g) Social Secretary;
(h) up to five ordinary Committee members, as determined by the AGM.

4.2 The Committee shall be elected at the AGM and shall hold office until the conclusion of the next AGM, subject to the provisions of Article 9 regarding the Chairperson’s term.

4.3 The Committee shall meet at least once every two months. The Secretary shall give at least seven days’ notice of each meeting to all Committee members.

**ARTICLE 4: THE COMMITTEE (continued)**

4.4 The Committee may co-opt additional voting members to fill a casual vacancy or to serve
in an advisory capacity. A co-opted member shall hold office until the conclusion of the next
AGM. Co-opted members shall have full voting rights on the Committee.

4.5 The Committee shall have the power to appoint sub-committees and to delegate to them such
functions as the Committee thinks fit. Each sub-committee shall report to the Committee at
each regular meeting. The Chairperson of each sub-committee shall be a member of the Committee.

4.6 The quorum for a Committee meeting shall be five, of whom at least two shall be elected
officers. No business shall be transacted at a Committee meeting unless a quorum is present.

4.7 A member of the Committee who is absent from three consecutive meetings without apology
accepted by the Committee shall cease to hold office, and the Committee may co-opt a
replacement in accordance with clause 4.4.

4.8 The Committee may, by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting, remove any
elected officer from office for conduct prejudicial to the Club, provided that the officer
concerned has been given at least 14 days’ written notice of the proposal and has been given
the opportunity to make representations to the Committee, in person or in writing, before the
vote is taken.

4.9 The minutes of all Committee meetings shall be kept by the Secretary and shall be made
available to any Full Member on request. Draft minutes shall be circulated to Committee
members within 14 days of the meeting.

4.10 The Committee shall be responsible for the maintenance of the Club’s financial records
and for the preparation of the annual accounts, in accordance with Article 5.

---

**ARTICLE 5: FINANCE**

5.1 The financial year of the Club shall run from 1 April to 31 March.

5.2 The annual subscription for each category of membership shall be proposed by the Committee
and approved by the AGM. Subscriptions shall be payable on or before 1 May in each year.
A member whose subscription remains unpaid after 31 May shall be deemed to have resigned,
provided that the Membership Secretary has sent a written reminder at least 14 days before
the expiry of the deadline.

5.3 The Treasurer shall keep proper books of account and shall present a statement of income
and expenditure and a balance sheet to the AGM. The accounts shall be examined by an
independent examiner appointed at the previous AGM.

5.4 The Treasurer shall open and maintain a bank account in the name of the Club. Cheques and
other payment instructions shall be signed by any two of the following: the Treasurer, the
Chairperson, the Secretary, and the Vice-Chairperson. No single signatory shall authorise a
payment on their own.

5.5 The Club shall not incur any capital expenditure exceeding £500 without the prior approval
of the Committee. Any single item of revenue expenditure exceeding £250 shall be reported to
the next Committee meeting.

5.6 The Committee shall insure the Club’s assets, including the Pavilion and its contents,
against fire, theft, and public liability, to a level it considers adequate.

5.7 The income and property of the Club shall be applied solely to the promotion of the
objects of the Club as set out in Article 2. No portion shall be paid or transferred, directly
or indirectly, to any member of the Club, except by way of reimbursement of expenses properly
incurred on behalf of the Club and approved by the Committee.

5.8 The Treasurer shall, at the request of the Committee, prepare a budget for the forthcoming
financial year, to be considered at the Committee meeting in February.

---

**ARTICLE 6: DISCIPLINE AND COMPLAINTS**
